scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.build:bundled: npm run build:web && npm run build:sidecar && go build -tags bundled_sidecar -o hy ./cmd/hy
scripts.build:sidecar: cd internal/adapter/claudecode/sidecar && npm install && bun build --compile sidecar.mjs --outfile dist/hy-claude-sidecar
scripts.test: npm run test:go && npm run test:web
scripts.clean: rm -f hy && rm -rf cmd/hy/webdist/assets cmd/hy/webdist/index.html && touch cmd/hy/webdist/.gitkeep
